faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Oriental Shorthair?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-14 lb (3-6.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Oriental Shorthair, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
